## Research at a glance

I'm fascinated by the internal structure of language models, practical information retrieval, and medical-facing computer vision systems. This Quarto preview deliberately leans into the conventions people actually use in research websites: a built-in about layout, clean Bootstrap typography, and listing-driven navigation.
